note: The release test. Every model release gets these six prompts, unchanged, with default settings and no system prompt. What comes back shows what the model reaches for on its own. Design prompts ask for one HTML file so the output can be rendered and compared.

prompts.prompt: Build a beautiful website for a bakery in Portland called Rye and Salt. Return one complete HTML file with inline CSS and no external resources.
Build the first screen of an operations app for routing delayed medical deliveries. Return one complete HTML file with inline CSS and no external resources.
Write a poem about a bakery at five in the morning.
Write the email to customers announcing that prices go up eight percent next month.
Write the homepage copy for a scheduling product used by independent home-care coordinators.
Write the error message a user sees when a bank transfer times out after they pressed submit.
